inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read the Blue-Node Convention in Your Own Chart
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## 如何在自己星盘里识别蓝色节点约定
inline.titleEn: 5 Steps to Demystify the Blue Node in Your Chart
inline.titleZh: 解读星盘中蓝色节点的5个步骤
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for identifying the blue node as the North Node in any birth chart software
inline.altZh: 识别任意星盘软件中蓝色节点即北交点的五步流程图

items.subEn: Find the blue symbol and confirm the chart legend labels it North Node
items.subZh: 找到蓝色符号，确认图例将其标注为北交点

items.subEn: Verify the South Node sits exactly 180° opposite — they form one axis
items.subZh: 确认南交点位于正对面180°处，两者构成同一条轴线

items.subEn: Check settings to see if your chart uses True Node or Mean Node
items.subZh: 查看软件设置，了解星盘使用真实节点还是平均节点

items.subEn: Open same birth data in another program — color changes, placement stays
items.subZh: 在另一软件中打开相同数据，颜色改变而位置不变

items.subEn: Read the node by sign and house; set the display color aside for good
items.subZh: 按星座与宫位解读节点，彻底放下显示颜色的执念

linesEn: Tracks the node's actual, slightly wobbling position
Can appear to drift or move backward over short spans
More precise degree — may shift sign near a cusp
linesZh: 追踪节点的实际位置，略有摆动
短期内可能出现逆行或漂移
度数更精确，临近宫首时可能跨越星座

linesEn: Uses a smoothed average of the node's orbital path
Moves steadily without any retrograde wobble
Slightly different degree — consistent and predictable
linesZh: 使用节点轨道的平滑平均值
度数略有差异，但始终一致且可预测
